data.title: WXML
data.tagline: A markup language for describing a WeChat mini program’s page structure and binding displayed data
data.learningOutcome: Distinguish adding page objects from styling them or implementing their actions.
data.description: On a booking screen, text and button tags define the visible objects, while a binding such as {{title}} displays page data. WXML places the objects; styles and click handling come from other files.

learning.assumes: You have seen a mini program page with text and buttons.
learning.outcome: Distinguish adding page objects from styling them or implementing their actions.

distinctions.label: WXSS
distinctions.explanation: Controls the appearance and layout of the objects declared in WXML.

distinctions.label: JavaScript
distinctions.explanation: Provides the data and handles actions. A button tag alone does not save a booking.

explanation.title: Bind data, rather than duplicate the page
explanation.text: {{title}} displays a field from page data. List and condition directives control which objects appear as data changes.

explanation.title: Use the platform’s components
explanation.text: WeChat uses tags such as view, text, and button. WXML resembles HTML but is not a browser document.

data.boundary: Declaring a button does not implement its action. Connect its event to page logic and verify the resulting record; unsupported browser tags and APIs cannot simply be copied.

lessonPractice.title: A booking screen needs an activity title and a button beneath it. Which change adds those objects?

options.label: Add the text and button tags in WXML
options.feedback: The template declares which objects are on the page.

options.label: Change the button color and spacing in WXSS
options.feedback: Styles change existing objects; they do not add this title and button.

options.label: Change the booking save handler in JavaScript
options.feedback: A save handler supplies behavior; it does not declare these visible objects.

data.agentPrompt: Add an activity title and booking button to this WeChat page’s WXML. Bind the title to page data and connect the button to existing booking logic. Change the activity name afterward and verify the title updates while booking still works.
